properties.name: WHAT WORKED (hxm_program, 2026-09-25): `unclaimed_findings` gave a crisp "9 subjects examined, 0 candidates" at session end — the third hxm session to report an honest empty answer from it
properties.statement: Recorded so a regression is checkable. Reporter (the hxm_program hub's session of 2026-09-25): "`unclaimed_findings` gave a crisp '9 subjects examined, 0 candidates' answer at session end." The same hub reported this on 2026-08-28 ("6 subjects examined, 0 candidates — a real 'nothing went stale' answer instead of silence") and on 2026-09-10 (honest shortlists of 0, 1 and 1). dev_storyflow saw the non-empty case on 2026-09-27 (fact:field-report-dev-storyflow-2026-09-27-worked-unclaimed-findings-scoped-to-a-sessions-changes). What must not regress: an empty answer names how many subjects were examined, so "nothing is stale" can be told apart from "nothing was looked at".
